title: The Confession of Ashcombe
author: Coral Okafor
blurb: Gideon Reyes, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
